region_definition: Development-set sources were sorted by right ascension (RA) and partitioned into five approximately equal-count, non-overlapping RA regions. Class labels were not used to construct the spatial regions.

models.F4: Random Forest, selected previously using development repeated CV
models.F7: LightGBM, selected previously using development repeated CV

evaluation_rule: Each complete RA region was held out once. The classifier was fitted on the remaining development regions and evaluated on the spatially disjoint held-out region.
